characters.name: Shazy
characters.role: narrator and main character, introduces himself, his friends and the story at the start of every video
characters.personality: Laid-back teen coder and skateboarder. Dislikes formal attire. Dry humour, overthinks small problems, loves tech and skating.
characters.speech_style: casual, quick, funny, talks to the viewer like a friend ('guys', 'so basically')
